about: An example rig: the desired setup of one studio's X32 Rack. FX buses first (1-8 feed FX 1-4), one Sampler bus switched between three samplers, the most played sources on ch 1-16 through user routing, and 12 Ableton returns from ch 21. The app's Setup panel checks the desk against this file and applies the difference (docs/x32-spec.md, 'Set up from the rig file'). Anything not listed here is left alone.

sources.name: Volca Kick
sources.notes: Via the Neutrik splitter box. Used for basslines.

sources.name: King Rat
sources.notes: Return of the King Rat loop (fed by bus 9). On a channel so it has an insert point and a direct out.

sources.name: Koala
sources.notes: Scarlett 6i6 outputs: the iPad and Koala

sources.name: Mic
sources.phantom: check: only if the mic is a condenser

unused.notes: Unnamed and white. The aux strips are also muted: their sockets now feed channels through user routing, or those sources would be heard twice. The buses are spare (a mono King Rat bus leaves bus 10 over).

spare.XLR 15-16: no channel: ch 21-32 are the Ableton returns

buses.name: King Rat
buses.notes: Aux outs run at +4 dBu, hotter than the King Rat expects: start sends low. Keep bus 9's send at zero on ch 4, the King Rat return.

buses.name: Sampler
buses.notes: One bus for all three samplers. It goes to the first target; the chat switches it by moving the output, and the other targets' outputs are off. Pre-fader, so samples include the channel's inserts, EQ and dynamics. Never send a sampler's own return to this bus while it's the target.

targets.name: SP-404 Mk2
targets.notes: The SP-404's line inputs are unbalanced and may drop about 6 dB: raise the bus level if samples come in low. Turn input monitoring off on the SP-404.

targets.name: Koala
targets.notes: Into the Scarlett's inputs. Turn input monitoring off in Koala.

targets.name: P-6
targets.notes: Into the P-6's MIX IN. Aux outs run at +4 dBu, hotter than MIX IN expects: start sends low. Turn input monitoring off on the P-6.

fx.notes: Reverb, as a send effect. The effect type is left as it is on the desk for now.
Delay, as a send effect, synced by the tempo bridge once that's built. The effect type is left as it is on the desk for now.
Second delay or modulation. The effect type is left as it is on the desk for now.
A fourth send effect. The effect type is left as it is on the desk for now.

card.notes: Each source records to Ableton as you hear it (post-fader), the effect returns in stereo, and the main mix as a reference. Card outs 21-22 are free.

manual: Set each line-level synth's preamp gain low, and save it in the scenes (the app never sets gain).
Turn input monitoring off on the SP-404, in Koala and on the P-6.
In Ableton, keep track monitoring off, listen through the X32, and match the X32's sample rate.
Use scene safes to keep preamp gains and the monitor level out of scene changes.
